name: Cloud Palace of Weather Layers
description: A surreal palace built from stacked clouds, each level representing a different weather phenomenon, with waterfalls of rain cascading between them.
prompt: Floating palace constructed from layers of fluffy clouds, each tier showing a distinct weather effect—sunny yellow, stormy gray, rainbows, soft mist—rain waterfalls linking levels, soft pastel sky, wide panoramic view, hyperrealistic, no text, whimsical fantasy.
caption: Live among the clouds—where each floor brings a new weather song, turning the palace into a living meteorologist.
